strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Look for a liquidity grab: price breaks support or resistance, fakes out, and then reverses. Enter at the candle that made the liquidity grab, with the direction depending on whether the grab is buy-side or sell-side liquidity.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab and take profit at a recent high for longs or a recent low for shorts; the speaker also frames this as a small-loss / large-win reversal trade.

variants.variant_label: sell-side or buy-side liquidity grab reversal
variants.timeframe_note: works on all time frames; examples shown on lower time frames
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: enter at the candle that initiated the liquidity grab / signal candle
variants.target_note: take profit at a recent high or low depending on direction
variants.transcript_quote: mark your entry point at the candle that made the liquidity grab

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: confirm the lower-timeframe liquidity grab with higher-timeframe support or resistance at the swing extreme
variants.target_note: normal stop loss and take profit after confirmation
variants.transcript_quote: move to a 1hour time frame and we see this Buy Signal signal happened exactly at a support on a higher time frame

canonical.enumeration_note: One liquidity-grab reversal skeleton is taught, with compatible variants for general all-timeframe execution and for higher-timeframe confluence; divergences are presented as a filter, not a separate strategy.
